description: This file defines a controller class for handling cookie-related functionalities in an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages displaying cookie information to users and processing their agreement or disagreement regarding cookies.

classes.name: Cookie
classes.description: Controller class for managing cookie consent display and processing within the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays cookie information and consent banner if conditions are met.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Processes user agreement or disagreement regarding cookies and sets a cookie accordingly.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the cookie consent message if cookie policy is not yet accepted.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Sets a cookie based on user's consent and returns a JSON response.
